title: The Sailor's Debt
description: Garrett took two hundred gold off us for ship repairs three weeks ago and drank it. He has gone to ground in Whaler's Abyss rather than face me. A debt unpaid once goes unpaid by everybody.

objectives.description: Track Garrett down in Whaler's Abyss
Get the 200 gold out of Garrett, however it takes
Bring the payment back to Raven

moral_choice.description: Garrett claims he needed the money for his sick daughter. You can forgive the debt or collect it.
moral_choice.good_option: Forgive the debt and pay it yourself
moral_choice.evil_option: Collect the debt regardless of circumstances

notes: Garrett at Whaler's Abyss (this file's own target text - the giver dialogue in raven_thief_contact.json says Crossroads tavern instead, a pre-existing mismatch out of this pass's scope). Threat: Garrett faces the Guild's collection one way or another - persuasion, intimidation or theft are all the same single objective mechanically. Giver motive: Raven can't let an unpaid debt become the Guild's reputation. Consequence: the moral_choice (forgive the debt, pay it yourself) and skill_checks blocks are decorative - no choice_consequences entry exists and nothing reads them, so obj_collect_debt is the only wired path regardless of how the description frames it. A full fix needs a real forgive_debt objective in an OR group with obj_collect_debt.
